Game Overview

In Mummy Land, the core idea is straightforward: guide a mummy through intricate pyramid levels in Mummy Land, an exciting platformer filled with cunning traps and mind-bending puzzles. Collect treasures and power-ups to boost your survival, as escalating challenges demand sharp wits and agile reflexes. Conquer the ancient labyrinth—will you make it out alive?
